title: Norwegian Bean Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish made with Norwegian beans, perfect for a quick dinner. This recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat the skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced green chili and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chopped Norwegian beans and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Add the chopped beans, water, and salt to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the liquid has thickened.
Serve the Norwegian bean skillet hot, garnished with chopped green chili if desired.
